first.rationale: Verify the strongest directly relevant evidence that shortening onboarding improves completion and time-to-value. Run a guarded self-serve test because both onboarding completion and activation are declining, while monitoring qualified pipeline, conversion quality, and retention so early activation gains do not mask downstream revenue harm.

final.rationale: Run a controlled onboarding simplification experiment for self-serve accounts. The verified record shows that shortening onboarding increased completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention by 3%, directly addressing the current completion and activation declines while supporting sustainable revenue. Use memory_31 and memory_91 as supporting, unverified context. Monitor qualified conversion, revenue quality, retention, and activation—not completion alone—to guard against downstream value loss.
